inclusions.source: A private, air-conditioned vehicle, a licensed, English-speaking Egyptologist guide, and one bottle of mineral water per person are included in every tier.

The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus all the site admissions below — including the three Valley of the Kings tombs, the tomb of Tutankhamun, and the tomb of Nefertari); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).

inclusions.text: All site admissions, including three Valley of the Kings tombs, the tomb of Tutankhamun and the tomb of Nefertari (Base + Entrance Fees and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch tiers only)
